availability.title: 24/7 Availability
availability.description: Our AI receptionist works around the clock with no breaks, holidays, or days off. Your customers can always book an appointment, whether it's the middle of the night, a weekend, or a public holiday. That means more bookings and higher customer satisfaction.

response.title: Instant Response
response.description: No waiting for your customers. The AI answers every call instantly and can handle unlimited simultaneous conversations. That means zero missed calls and maximum customer satisfaction at all times.

calendar.title: Smart Calendar Integration
calendar.description: Seamless integration with your existing booking system. The AI sees your real calendar in real time and only books available slots. Every appointment syncs automatically with detailed notes about the conversation and the customer's needs.

danish.title: Fluent and Natural
danish.description: Our AI is trained specifically on natural language and local cultural norms. It understands accents and slang and speaks naturally. Your customers enjoy a pleasant, professional conversation every single time.

saveTime.title: Save 10+ Hours a Week
saveTime.description: Free up time that used to go to answering the phone, managing bookings, and sending reminders. Spend it growing your business instead.

increaseRevenue.title: Increase Revenue by 30%
increaseRevenue.description: Capture every lead 24/7 and reduce lost bookings. More bookings and fewer no-shows mean directly increased revenue.

noMissedCalls.title: Zero Missed Calls
noMissedCalls.description: Every unanswered call is lost revenue. With the AI receptionist, no call is ever missed - even when you're busy, in a meeting, or outside business hours.

betterExperience.title: A Better Customer Experience
betterExperience.description: Consistently high service quality every time. No bad days, no stress-induced mistakes. Your customers always experience a professional, friendly receptionist.

fullDocumentation.title: Complete Documentation
